positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Project co-lead for new corporate website using Angular 2, Typescript, Node.js, and Microsoft Azure Services for hosting, blob storage, and CDN
Built and maintained multiple responsive sites for Scott Rudin/Broadway, including Javascript HTML5 Animation using GreenSock Animation Platform
Assembled web banner ads for multiple campaigns using Javascript, GSAP, HTML5/CSS3

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Project lead for DarkVision, a web application for custom monitoring of IPs/URLs of interest; built using PHP, MySQL, AngularJS, D3.js (NVD3), HTML & CSS. Co-lead for internal tool used to monitor daily/hourly maintenance of several products accessed company-wide; built using PHP, MySQL, AngularJS, HTML & CSS. Support web interface for DarkWatch appliance using Python, Django, Javascript, HTML & CSS on FreeBSD. Project lead for implementing REST-style API interface using Django Tastypie; customized several resources to configure DarkWatch appliance via API

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Support web application to connect lenders with consumers on both front and back ends using PHP, Javascript, MySQL, HTML & CSS. Structure and implement new feature - FreedomPlus - an application using BoltCMS for content editing, PHP, Javascript, jQuery, and Bootstrap (http://www.freedomplus.com/). Project lead for separation of Bills.com from lead-related logic; includes separation of relevant controllers and database tables

positions.title: Web Coordinator / Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Facilitate discussion for Public Health course - “Seminar on Social, Political, and Ethical Issues in Health and Medicine;" develop weekly curricula on course topics and maintain weekly homework assignment website

projects.title: BeerMe
projects.description:
A beer discovery web application utilizing Python, SQLAlchemy, Flask, WTForms, HTML and CSS. The Pearson product-moment correlation coefficient algorithm is used to assess and predict ratings for users based on peer ratings
@BeerMeBeers

projects.title: @R2_Dub2 Twitterbot
projects.description: Markov text generator combining select “lyrics” from Star Wars character R2D2 and dubstep music. Python and Twitter API used to post live to Twitter
